questionAnswered: Whether admin banner deletion removes admin-uploaded image files.

currentBannerBehavior.uploadStorage: Admin banner data URLs are persisted under public/uploads/admin/banners and exposed as /uploads/admin/banners/...
currentBannerBehavior.replacementCleanup: Banner update deletes replaced managed admin uploads after the database update succeeds.
currentBannerBehavior.deleteCleanup: Banner delete deletes the database row, then attempts cleanup of imageUrl and mobileImageUrl when they are managed admin uploads.

currentRelatedMediaBehavior.categories: Category uploads use /uploads/admin/categories. Hard delete removes the managed upload; archive path leaves image in place.
currentRelatedMediaBehavior.products: Product uploads use /uploads/products. Product update/delete attempts cleanup for removed managed product images.
currentRelatedMediaBehavior.brands: Schema has brand logo/banner fields, but no active admin brand CRUD route/component was found in this audit.

safeDeletionContract.deletable: Only normalized files inside /uploads/admin/ or /uploads/products/ that resolve under public uploads roots.
safeDeletionContract.notDeletable: Source-code assets, remote URLs, data URLs, unknown local paths, traversal, query/hash paths, null-byte paths, and upload root directories.
futureRequiredBeforeProductionRuntimeExp: provider/object-storage deletion by owned storage key
